displayName: Report-spec folders and the Portal's held specs
description: The report-spec consumer folder tree (RootCollection::ReportSpecs and one folder per tool), then the Portal's two report specs held in Egeria, filed in ReportSpecFolder::Consumer::Portal. Runs after Dashboard Folders and before Useful Dashboards (see _folder_order.json).
idempotentReason: Every command is check-then-create: Creates carry a qualifiedName (upsert); Add Member to Collection updates an existing membership (Egeria CollectionHandler.addToCollection, CollectionHandler.java:2309-2322, origin/main 0f5bf00c; it sees only memberships the running user can see); Parent ID on Create Report Spec is add-only and returns when already linked (pyegeria md_processing/v2/processors.py:519-520, upstream 18178917, since 6.2.32).
